name: Carousel of Ambition
descriptionTemplate: [{Infinite Devour}: This {Carousel of Ambition} deals +[Arg3] {plural:[Arg3]|instance|instances} of DMG, HP Recovery +[Heal:Arg6].] Randomly deal [Damage:Arg2] DMG [Arg1] {plural:[Arg1]|time|times}. Restore [Heal:Arg4] HP at turn end.
lore:
In Sorel's salon, the final round dance before closing is a cherished tradition.
Under the influence of alcohol and hormones, no matter if it's a neighboring prince, a court official, or a personal maid, everyone joins hands and dives into the dance floor for a wild celebration.
As the music fades and the salon empties, nothing remains by Sorel's side except power and the faint dawn light breaking over the horizon.
